question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
      AND IS_CANCELLED = FALSE
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
      AND IS_CANCELLED = FALSE
),
jan_jun_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jan_jun_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
jul_dec_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jul_dec_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec;

action.answer: In January–June 2025, there were 94,512 repeat customers (customers with more than one non-cancelled order in that period). In July–December 2025, there were 96,095 repeat customers (customers with more than one non-cancelled order in that period). The second half of 2025 (July–December) had more repeat customers than the first half.
action.reason: Repeat status was evaluated separately for each half-year period, counting customers with more than one non-cancelled order in each respective period. 96,095 > 94,512, so July–December had more repeat customers.
